name: Customer History Report
sql_query:
WITH cus AS (
    SELECT Code, NIC FROM customers WHERE BC = :bc AND Code = :customer
),
tx AS (
    -- Sales invoice (charge)
    SELECT s.Invoice_date AS tx_date, 1 AS seq, s.Invoice_no AS ref_no, 'Sales Invoice' AS tx_type,
           (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(d.Item_description, ' x', d.QTY) SEPARATOR ', ')
              FROM t_invoice_deils d WHERE d.Invoice_no = s.Invoice_no) AS description,
           s.Net_Amount AS debit, 0 AS credit
    FROM t_invoice_sums s JOIN cus ON cus.Code = s.customer_code
    WHERE s.BC = :bc

    -- Paid at the time of sale (advances are counted when they are received)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT s.Invoice_date, 2, s.Invoice_no, 'Payment at Sale',
           CONCAT_WS(', ',
               IF(s.Cash_Pay      > 0, CONCAT('Cash ', FORMAT(s.Cash_Pay, 2)), NULL),
               IF(s.card_payment  > 0, CONCAT('Card ', FORMAT(s.card_payment, 2)), NULL),
               IF(s.Cheque        > 0, CONCAT('Cheque ', FORMAT(s.Cheque, 2)), NULL),
               IF(s.bank_transfer > 0, CONCAT('Bank ', FORMAT(s.bank_transfer, 2)), NULL),
               IF(s.advance_applied > 0, CONCAT('Advance used ', FORMAT(s.advance_applied, 2)), NULL)),
           0, s.Cash_Pay + s.card_payment + s.Cheque + s.bank_transfer
    FROM t_invoice_sums s JOIN cus ON cus.Code = s.customer_code
    WHERE s.BC = :bc AND s.Cash_Pay + s.card_payment + s.Cheque + s.bank_transfer + s.advance_applied > 0

    -- Later payments against invoices
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.Payment_date, 3, p.Payment_no, 'Customer Payment',
           CONCAT_WS(' - ',
               (SELECT CONCAT('For ', GROUP_CONCAT(a.sales_invoice_no SEPARATOR ', '))
                  FROM t_customer_invoice_payments a WHERE a.payment_no = p.Payment_no),
               NULLIF(p.Payment_note, '')),
           0, p.Payment_Amount
    FROM t_customer_payments p JOIN cus ON cus.NIC = p.Customer_NIC
    WHERE p.BC = :bc

    -- Advance payments received
    UNION ALL
    SELECT v.payment_date, 3, v.payment_no, 'Advance Payment', v.payment_note, 0, v.amount
    FROM t_advanc_cus_payments v JOIN cus ON cus.NIC = v.customer_nic
    WHERE v.BC = :bc

    -- Sales returns (credit to the account; cash refunds shown in the description)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, 4, r.return_no, 'Sales Return',
           CONCAT('Invoice ', r.invoice_no,
                  IF(r.refund_amount > 0, CONCAT(' - refunded ', FORMAT(r.refund_amount, 2), ' (', r.refund_method, ')'), '')),
           0, r.credit_adjustment
    FROM t_sales_return_sums r JOIN cus ON cus.NIC = r.customer_nic
    WHERE r.BC = :bc AND r.status = 'posted'

    -- Hire purchase agreement (full contract amount incl. interest and charges)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT h.invoice_date, 1, h.invoice_no, IF(h.is_opening = 1, 'HP Agreement (Opening)', 'HP Agreement'),
           CONCAT('Agreement ', h.agreement_no, ' - ',
                  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(d.item_description, ' x', d.qty) SEPARATOR ', ')
                     FROM t_hire_purchase_details d WHERE d.invoice_no = h.invoice_no),
                  ' - ', h.no_of_instalment, ' x ', FORMAT(h.instalment_amount, 2)),
           h.contract_amount, 0
    FROM t_hire_purchase_sums h JOIN cus ON cus.Code = h.customer_code
    WHERE h.BC = :bc

    -- HP down payment, or the amount already paid before an opening agreement was entered
    UNION ALL
    SELECT h.invoice_date, 2, h.invoice_no,
           IF(h.is_opening = 1, 'Paid Before Opening', 'HP Down Payment'),
           CONCAT('Agreement ', h.agreement_no),
           0,
           IF(h.is_opening = 1,
              h.contract_amount - h.outstanding_amount
                  - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.principal_amount + p.discount_amount)
                                FROM t_hp_installment_payments p
                               WHERE p.invoice_no = h.invoice_no AND p.status = 'posted'), 0),
              h.down_payment)
    FROM t_hire_purchase_sums h JOIN cus ON cus.Code = h.customer_code
    WHERE h.BC = :bc AND (h.is_opening = 1 OR h.down_payment > 0)

    -- HP installment collections (penalty is charged; principal + discount reduce the balance)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.payment_date, 3, p.payment_no, 'HP Installment',
           CONCAT('Agreement ', h.agreement_no, ' - inst. #', i.instalment_no,
                  IF(p.penalty_amount  > 0, CONCAT(' - penalty ', FORMAT(p.penalty_amount, 2)), ''),
                  IF(p.discount_amount > 0, CONCAT(' - discount ', FORMAT(p.discount_amount, 2)), '')),
           p.penalty_amount, p.total_amount + p.discount_amount
    FROM t_hp_installment_payments p
    JOIN t_hire_purchase_sums h ON h.invoice_no = p.invoice_no
    JOIN cus ON cus.Code = h.customer_code
    LEFT JOIN t_instalments i ON i.id = p.instalment_id
    WHERE p.BC = :bc AND p.status = 'posted'

    -- HP converted to a cash sale (settlement + amount written off as discount)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.conversion_date, 3, c.conversion_no, 'HP Cash Conversion',
           CONCAT('Agreement ', c.agreement_no, ' - settled ', FORMAT(c.amount, 2),
                  IF(c.due_amount_as_discount + c.discount > 0, CONCAT(', discount ', FORMAT(c.due_amount_as_discount + c.discount, 2)), '')),
           0, c.amount + c.due_amount_as_discount + c.discount
    FROM t_hire_purchase_to_sales c
    JOIN t_hire_purchase_sums h ON h.invoice_no = c.invoice_no
    JOIN cus ON cus.Code = h.customer_code
    WHERE c.BC = :bc

    -- HP returns (outstanding written off; refunds shown in the description)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT hr.return_date, 4, hr.hpreturn_code, 'HP Return',
           CONCAT('Agreement ', hr.agreement_no,
                  IF(hr.refund_amount > 0, CONCAT(' - refunded ', FORMAT(hr.refund_amount, 2)), '')),
           0, hr.outstanding_written_off
    FROM t_hire_purchase_return_sums hr JOIN cus ON cus.NIC = hr.customer_nic
    WHERE hr.bc = :bc AND hr.status = 'posted'
),
history AS (
    SELECT tx.*,
           SUM(debit - credit) OVER (ORDER BY tx_date, seq, ref_no ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS balance
    FROM tx
)
SELECT tx_date, tx_type, ref_no, description, debit, credit, balance
FROM (
    -- Opening balance (only when a From date is chosen)
    SELECT 0 AS grp, :from AS tx_date, 0 AS seq, '' AS ref_no, 'Opening Balance' AS tx_type, '' AS description,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0), 0) AS debit,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(SUM(credit - debit), 0), 0) AS credit,
           COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS balance
    FROM tx
    WHERE tx_date < :from
    HAVING :from IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 1, tx_date, seq, ref_no, tx_type, description, debit, credit, balance
    FROM history
    WHERE (:from IS NULL OR tx_date >= :from)
      AND (:to   IS NULL OR tx_date <= :to)
) statement
ORDER BY grp, tx_date, seq, ref_no;
